description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
